description: Source code for the integrity_engine_nia2_cmac class implementing CMAC-based integrity protection and verification using mbedtls library, specific to 3GPP security specifications.

classes.name: integrity_engine_nia2_cmac
classes.description: Class implementing CMAC-based integrity protection and verification for 3GPP security.

methods.name: compute_mac
methods.description: Calculates CMAC over input data with a preamble including count, bearer ID, and direction.

methods.name: protect_integrity
methods.description: Applies integrity protection to a buffer by computing and appending a MAC.

methods.name: verify_integrity
methods.description: Verifies the integrity of a buffer by comparing the computed MAC with the received MAC.
